issue.title: queue counters are not getting populated for voq systems.

failure.body:
#### Description

queuestat is returns no counters for both normal egress queue and voq counters.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Enable queue counters
2. do a queuestat or queuestat -V and the counters are not populated.

#### Describe the results you received:

The counters were empty for egress queue counter and N/A for voq

#### Describe the results you expected:

Expected non zero counters for ports that were active.

resolution.title: swss: Fix Invalid port oid messages generated because of voq counters.
resolution.description:
**What I did**

* Do not add Voq oids to CounterCheckOrch since CounterCheckOrch is not relevant for voqs. Fixed https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/13662 where voq counters stopped working after https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/pull/2525

**Why I did it**

To fix the invalid oids messages generated by CounterCheckOrch for voq.

**How I verified it**

Verified that the invalid port oid messages go away. Verified voq counters.
